aiOverview.content: PlayStation Plus is a subscription service for PlayStation consoles that offers online multiplayer, monthly games, cloud storage, and exclusive discounts. It is divided into three tiers—Essential ($9.99/mo), Extra ($14.99/mo), and Premium ($17.99/mo)—with higher tiers adding extensive game catalogs and cloud streaming. PlayStation Plus Subscription Tiers (USD Pricing) Essential ($9.99/mo, $24.99/3 mo, $79.99/yr): Includes online multiplayer, two or three monthly games, exclusive discounts, and cloud storage. Extra ($14.99/mo, $39.99/3 mo, $134.99/yr): Includes all Essential benefits, plus a catalog of up to 400+ downloadable PS4 and PS5 games. Premium/Deluxe ($17.99/mo, $49.99/3 mo, $159.99/yr): Includes all Extra benefits, plus a Classics Catalog (PS1, PS2, PS3, PSP), game trials, and cloud streaming for select games. Key Benefits Monthly Games: Users can add new games to their library each month. Game Catalog: Access hundreds of downloadable PS4 and PS5 titles, including Ubisoft+ Classics. Cloud Streaming: Stream games directly to a PS5 or PC (Premium only). Exclusive Content: Access members-only deals, discounts, and in-game items. Effective January 2026, Sony has shifted focus toward offering more PS5 games as part of the monthly benefits, reducing the frequency of PS4 game offerings.
